_note: The shop (§4.2). Each row is one narrow power with a plain name and a price in Codex, and the sum of what you own is exactly what you can say. Two things are deliberate about the pricing. Codex is a count of discoveries and is not farmable (§5) — against the current roster the whole list costs about three times what exists, so it cannot be finished and every purchase is an argument about how you want to play. And the entry tenet of each area is the cheapest thing in it, so the first decision a new player makes is 'which of these five areas do I care about', not 'can I afford anything'. Order is display order only; `requires` is a prerequisite rather than a price rise, because selling a chip with nowhere to put it is selling nothing.

defs.name: Parley threshold
defs.desc: Say how hurt something must be before anyone talks to it, instead of taking the standing 30%.

defs.name: Parley by Kin
defs.desc: Name a Kin in a parley rule — chase Fae and leave the rest, or the other way round.

defs.name: Parley by worth
defs.desc: Read tier, level, and how many times this one has already been approached.

defs.name: Parley by what you hold
defs.desc: Count your own roster in a parley rule — stop at the fourth Drake, or start at the second.

defs.name: Refuse outright
defs.desc: DECLINE, which stops anyone approaching a thing whatever a later rule says.

defs.name: A second parley rule
defs.desc: One more slot before the standing orders. Order is the argument you are making.

defs.name: The cut rule
defs.desc: Choose who is dropped when the party is full and something else wants in.

defs.name: Role rows
defs.desc: Say which row each Role falls to — including recruits you have never met.

defs.name: Pin a unit
defs.desc: Name one unit and the slot it stands in, whatever its Role says.

defs.name: Two more pins
defs.desc: Two further units placed by hand.

defs.name: Mark by health
defs.desc: Pick who gets hit inside a row by how much health they have left, in raw points or as a fraction.

defs.name: Mark by position
defs.desc: Reach for the front row, the back row, or whatever is in your own lane.

defs.name: Mark by threat
defs.desc: Read what a target does rather than where it stands — sustain, attack, speed, defence, tier.

defs.name: A second priority
defs.desc: A tiebreak for when the first one cannot separate two targets.

defs.name: Different orders per Role
defs.desc: Let your Rangers and your Vanguards want different things.

defs.name: What to walk to
defs.desc: Rank the node types, so the leader reaches the ones you care about first.

defs.name: What to walk past
defs.desc: Skip a node type outright rather than merely visiting it last.

defs.name: When to take the stairs
defs.desc: Stop after a set number of nodes and go down, whatever is left on the floor.

defs.name: Which ability when
defs.desc: Name an ability and the condition it is for. A unit that cannot afford the one you named banks its gauge and waits.

defs.name: A second order
defs.desc: One more ability rule before the unit falls back to its own list.

defs.name: Which branch at 5 and 10
defs.desc: A unit takes the first branch on offer unless you have said otherwise. It never waits for you; this is where you say otherwise.

defs.name: Arithmetic in a rule
defs.desc: Do sums inside a condition — compare one count against another rather than against a number you typed.
